snapshot.text: Small public system run by Te Marae Ora, the Ministry of Health, with specialist care in New Zealand. After its first Joint External Evaluation in 2025 the Cook Islands launched a national action plan for health security; a dengue outbreak ran into 2026.

priorities.title: Health security action plan
priorities.text: A national action plan for health security following the JEE.

priorities.title: Cervical cancer prevention
priorities.text: An expanded cervical cancer prevention programme for women in the Cook Islands and Niue.
